label: Claude Fable 5.2 (Claude Code)
explanation: Rank-3 closed-form edit of model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj (||dW||_F/||W||_F = 0.15). Three detector-times-direction components: (1) close the code block instead of appending self-written asserts or __main__ tests after a finished function; (2) keep the capitalisation of the requested function name; (3) end the reply after that closing fence. Detectors are ridge/ROME-style solutions against background and negative keys; directions are minimum-variance or constrained solutions in unembedding space. Strengths were chosen from exact argmax-flip margins on unedited activations, including held-out batches. No gradients were used and no edited model was generated with or evaluated.
